html:
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="{{DESCRIPTION}}">
<meta name="keywords" content="{{KEYWORDS}}">
<meta property="og:image" content="{{OGP_IMAGE}}">
<title>{{FULL_TITLE}}</title>
{{HEAD_CSS}}
memo: Shared head tags. {{HEAD_CSS}} is the tag that collects the CSS of pages and components and outputs it in order (without it, the CSS goes right before </head>). Missing charset, viewport, title, description and OGP image tags are also added automatically. Tracking tags go into the head of every page when you enter a tracking ID or tracking code in Site settings.
